guides.title: 工程檔案：關鍵數據、年代、規範與案例
guides.titleEn: Engineering dossier: key figures, timeline, codes and landmarks
guides.concept: 以刀具軌跡、接觸荷重與磨耗證據解釋掘進刀具壽命。本頁區分公開工程資料與明示的教學假設；數值只用於學習比較，不是設計值。
guides.conceptEn: Explain cutter life using trajectories, contact loads and wear evidence. This dossier distinguishes public project facts from explicitly labelled teaching assumptions; figures are for learning comparisons, not design values.
facts: 教學量化備忘：假設刀位半徑5 m、轉速4 rpm，切向速度v=2πrn/60=2.094 m/s；不代表建議轉速。
教學量化備忘：假設推進30 mm/min、轉速3 rpm，每轉進尺p=10 mm/rev；未提供刀具容許荷重。
教學量化備忘：假設扣除非切削阻力後有效推力10 MN分到40刀，平均250 kN/刀；不等於每刀實際受力。
教學量化備忘：假設平均扭矩2 MN·m、轉10圈、開挖20 m³，E=2πTn/V=6.283 MJ/m³，僅旋轉部分。
教學量化備忘：假設徑向磨耗3 mm歷經600 m，平均0.005 mm/m；此率不能無條件外推到下一岩層。
教學量化備忘：假設正常溫度40°C、觀測65°C，升幅25 K；此差只供教學診斷，不是通用軸承警戒值。
factsEn: Teaching quantitative note: Assume cutter radius 5 m and rotation 4 rpm; tangential speed v=2πrn/60=2.094 m/s, not a recommended speed.
Teaching quantitative note: Assume advance 30 mm/min and rotation 3 rpm; penetration p=10 mm/rev, without specifying allowable cutter load.
Teaching quantitative note: Assume effective cutting thrust 10 MN after removing other resistance, shared by 40 tools; the mean is 250 kN/tool, not each tool's actual load.
Teaching quantitative note: Assume mean torque 2 MN·m, 10 revolutions and excavation 20 m³; E=2πTn/V=6.283 MJ/m³ for rotation only.
Teaching quantitative note: Assume radial wear 3 mm over 600 m; mean rate is 0.005 mm/m, not transferable unconditionally to the next stratum.
Teaching quantitative note: Assume normal temperature 40°C and observation 65°C; the rise is 25 K, a diagnostic illustration rather than a universal bearing alarm.
timeline: 2009　美國聯邦公路管理局出版公路隧道土建手冊
2016　瑞士聖哥達基線隧道投入營運，提供長隧道背景對照
2017　Crossrail公開地質縱剖面完工更新與適用限制
timelineEn: 2009 — FHWA publishes its civil-elements manual for road tunnels
2016 — The Gotthard Base Tunnel enters operation, providing a long-tunnel comparison context
2017 — Crossrail publishes its updated geological section and interpretation limitations

香港岩土指南二：場地勘察，2017更新

landmarks: 倫敦Crossrail：公開調查與建設背景
聖哥達基線隧道：深埋岩體對照
landmarksEn: London Crossrail: public investigation and construction context
procedure: 把關鍵數據與本課算例逐項對照，標出哪些是公開工程數據、哪些是教學假設。
沿著工程時間軸，標出設計、施工、事件與維護改造的關鍵決策點，說明每個決策改變了哪一條系統路徑或檢核。
對照列出的規範與標準，找出本課試驗或允收步驟對應的條款類型，並註明版本與適用地區。
從代表工程中選一個與本課比較，列出埋深或斷面、地質水文、支護系統與施工方法的差異。
procedureEn: Compare the key figures with this course's worked example and mark which are public project data and which are teaching assumptions.
Along the timeline, mark the key design, construction, event and retrofit decisions and say which system path or check each one changed.
Against the listed codes and standards, find the kind of clause behind this course's tests or acceptance steps, noting edition and jurisdiction.
Pick one landmark project to compare with this course and list differences in depth or section, ground and groundwater, support system and construction method.
pitfalls: 把四捨五入的公開數據當成設計值或允收值使用。
沒有確認規範版本、適用地區與荷載組合就直接套用另一國的條文。
pitfallsEn: Using rounded public figures as design or acceptance values.
Applying another country's clauses without checking edition, jurisdiction and load combinations.

guides.scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、開挖、注漿或受限空間作業許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
guides.scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, excavation, grouting or confined-space permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

guides.title: 機制、算例與驗證：潛盾機刀具磨耗管理
guides.titleEn: Mechanisms, calculations and verification: TBM cutter-wear management
guides.concept: 本課聚焦以刀具軌跡、接觸荷重與磨耗證據解釋掘進刀具壽命。沿著調查依據、物理作用、數量估算、現場驗證到工程交接逐項建立可追溯的推論鏈，特別辨別單一數值無法揭露的空間差異及時間效應。以獨立量測檢驗簡化模型，並把觀測結果、教學假設與需要主管工程師審查的決策清楚分列。
guides.conceptEn: This course focuses on explain cutter life using trajectories, contact loads and wear evidence. It develops a traceable reasoning chain from evidence and physical processes through quantitative estimates, field verification and engineering handover. Spatial variation and time effects are separated from a single nominal result. Independent observations test the simplified models, while measured evidence, teaching assumptions and decisions requiring the responsible engineer remain explicitly distinguished.
procedure: 不同半徑刀具每轉走過不同距離，外緣刀即使承受相同轉數也有較長接觸路徑。磨耗比較須規一化里程或體積並保留刀位，不能用更換次數直接推斷材料品質。 假設刀位半徑5 m、轉速4 rpm，切向速度v=2πrn/60=2.094 m/s；不代表建議轉速。 把外緣刀較快磨耗全歸於材料缺陷會錯判供應品質，刀位更換後仍沿用舊行程又會污染趨勢；壽命模型因此對下一段地層失去可比性。
每轉進尺把推進速率與轉速連結，反映刀具每次通過的切入尺度，但它也受岩體裂隙與刀具間距影響。高進尺未必代表高效率，過大載重可能使刀環或軸承提早失效。 假設推進30 mm/min、轉速3 rpm，每轉進尺p=10 mm/rev；未提供刀具容許荷重。 轉速讀值或里程時間不一致會製造假高進尺，軟弱帶自然崩解也可能看似切削優秀；若據此增加荷重，進入硬岩後可能超出刀具能力。
總推力包含刀具切削、盾體摩擦及其他阻力，除以刀具數只是粗略平均。混合面與刀盤變形會造成偏載，真正限制可能是單刀峰值而非平均，所以需要位置與工況證據。 假設扣除非切削阻力後有效推力10 MN分到40刀，平均250 kN/刀；不等於每刀實際受力。 少數刀先接觸硬塊時可能承受高衝擊而平均推力正常，若忽略偏載便無法解釋局部刀環崩裂；盲目增加總推力可能使問題惡化。
扭矩功除以開挖體積得到旋轉比能，可比較破岩代價但不包含全部系統能耗。磨耗、節理及運碴再研磨都會影響它，必須將機械狀態和地質相符的區段放在一起比較。 假設平均扭矩2 MN·m、轉10圈、開挖20 m³，E=2πTn/V=6.283 MJ/m³，僅旋轉部分。 運碴不良造成重複碾碎會抬高比能，若誤當岩石變硬便可能錯調推力；出土體積估錯又讓能量指標看似改善而實際效率下降。
刀環徑向損失反映磨蝕，但壽命並非沿全程固定線性；礦物、顆粒與含水改變會使速率跳變。計算前需把更換和刀位移動分開，且保留接近極限時的非線性劣化可能。 假設徑向磨耗3 mm歷經600 m，平均0.005 mm/m；此率不能無條件外推到下一岩層。 跨岩性平均會低估磨蝕帶的即時消耗，量具基準改變又會製造假回復；錯誤壽命預估可能讓需要計畫檢查的刀具過晚被辨識。
刀環磨耗是接觸表面的漸進損失，軸承故障則可能使刀具停止滾動並產生滑磨，兩者症狀不同。溫度、聲振和磨耗形態需要合併，不能只量剩餘直徑就判斷可用性。 假設正常溫度40°C、觀測65°C，升幅25 K；此差只供教學診斷，不是通用軸承警戒值。 卡死刀具會由滾動變滑動，局部發熱和刀環損失加速，總扭矩初期卻未必明顯；只靠平均刀盤訊號可能漏掉早期單刀故障。
刀具每轉穿越硬軟界面會反覆載入卸載，平均力無法代表疲勞與衝擊。界面位置、硬塊尺寸和旋轉速度共同控制循環數與幅值，需把事件和刀位路徑對齊。 假設每轉有2次硬軟轉換、轉速3 rpm、持續100 h，轉換次數2×3×60×100=36000次。 取樣頻率不足會把衝擊平均掉，刀具卻持續承受疲勞；只統計轉數又忽略硬軟界面轉換，可能誤把局部崩裂當成偶然製造缺陷。
相鄰刀槽之間的裂縫若能連通，岩石以較大碴片剝離；間距、貫入與岩性不匹配時會變成重複研磨。幾何比只描述相對尺度，不能不經試驗就轉成通用最佳刀間距。 假設刀間距80 mm、貫入10 mm，比值s/p=8；相同比值在不同岩性不保證相同比能。 粉碴增加可能表示研磨、磨鈍或岩性改變，不能一律歸於間距不當；若只追求大碴片也可能忽略排碴能力和混合面衝擊的限制。
同一刀具可能在不同位置使用並經維修，序號、刀位與時間共同決定實際歷程。更換刀環不一定重置軸承壽命，資料庫必須分辨組件層級，否則新舊零件會混成同一壽命樣本。 假設刀環使用400 h更換、軸承此前已200 h，若軸承未換則累積600 h，不是400 h或零。 序號抄錯會把早期故障歸到另一批次，更換整刀與只換刀環未區分則誇大或低估壽命；供應比較和備件計畫都會被錯誤歷程影響。
刀具維護需整合剩餘厚度、軸承狀態、預測地層與可檢查窗口，不能由單一磨耗率自動決定。資料驅動判讀只支持專業決策，刀盤或加壓艙的接近仍是獨立的高風險核准工作。 假設40刀中36刀有最新有效狀態，覆蓋90%；其餘4刀若位於同一高負荷區，不能以整體比例忽略。 只按平均磨耗安排檢查可能漏掉一顆卡死刀具，預測模型若未更新新岩層也會過度樂觀；忽略這些限制會讓規劃數字被誤當現場許可。
procedureEn: Tools at different radii travel different distances per revolution. Outer cutters therefore accumulate longer contact paths at equal revolutions, requiring wear normalization by travel or excavation and retention of cutter position rather than replacement count alone. Assume cutter radius 5 m and rotation 4 rpm; tangential speed v=2πrn/60=2.094 m/s, not a recommended speed. Attributing faster outer wear solely to material defects misjudges quality, while retaining old travel after relocation corrupts trends. The resulting life model loses comparability for the next geological reach.

Penetration per revolution links advance and rotation to cutting scale, but also depends on fractures and spacing. High penetration is not automatically efficient if excessive load damages cutter rings or bearings prematurely. Assume advance 30 mm/min and rotation 3 rpm; penetration p=10 mm/rev, without specifying allowable cutter load. Unsynchronized speed and distance create false high penetration, while weak-ground disintegration can mimic excellent cutting. Increasing load on that evidence may exceed tool capability when harder ground returns.

Total thrust includes cutting, shield friction and other resistance, making division by cutter count only a rough mean. Mixed ground and cutterhead deformation create uneven loads, with individual peaks potentially governing instead of the average. Assume effective cutting thrust 10 MN after removing other resistance, shared by 40 tools; the mean is 250 kN/tool, not each tool's actual load. A few tools meeting a hard inclusion can suffer high impact with normal mean thrust. Ignoring uneven loading leaves localized ring fracture unexplained and may worsen it through increased total thrust.

Rotational work per excavated volume measures cutting cost but excludes other system energy. Wear, joints and regrinding affect it, requiring matched geological and mechanical conditions for meaningful comparisons. Assume mean torque 2 MN·m, 10 revolutions and excavation 20 m³; E=2πTn/V=6.283 MJ/m³ for rotation only. Poor muck removal raises energy through regrinding and may be misread as harder rock. Incorrect excavated volume can conversely make the energy index appear better while actual efficiency deteriorates.

Radial loss measures abrasion, but life is not uniformly linear along a drive. Mineralogy, grains and water change rates abruptly. Separate replacements and relocation and retain the possibility of accelerated deterioration near a limiting condition. Assume radial wear 3 mm over 600 m; mean rate is 0.005 mm/m, not transferable unconditionally to the next stratum. Averaging across lithologies understates current wear in an abrasive band, while changed measuring datums create false recovery. The resulting life estimate identifies tools requiring planned inspection too late.

Ring wear is gradual surface loss, whereas bearing failure can stop rotation and create sliding abrasion. Temperature, vibration and wear shape are complementary, and remaining diameter alone cannot establish tool condition. Assume normal temperature 40°C and observation 65°C; the rise is 25 K, a diagnostic illustration rather than a universal bearing alarm. A seized tool slides rather than rolls, accelerating heat and local wear while total torque may initially change little. Average cutterhead signals can therefore miss the early failure of one cutter.

Crossing a hard-soft interface repeatedly loads and unloads a tool. Mean force cannot represent fatigue and impact; interface position, inclusion size and rotation together control cycling, requiring events to be aligned with cutter trajectories. Assume 2 transitions per revolution at 3 rpm over 100 h; transition count is 2×3×60×100=36000. Slow sampling averages impacts away while fatigue continues. Counting revolutions without interface crossings may wrongly classify localized chipping as a random manufacturing defect rather than repeated loading.

Connected cracks between neighboring tracks release larger chips, while mismatched spacing, penetration and rock behavior promote regrinding. A geometry ratio describes relative scale without establishing a universal optimum spacing absent testing. For assumed spacing 80 mm and penetration 10 mm, s/p=8; the same ratio in different rocks does not guarantee equal specific energy. More fines may indicate regrinding, blunt tools or changed geology rather than spacing alone. Maximizing chip size can also neglect muck-handling capacity and impact limitations in mixed ground.

A tool may be relocated and rebuilt, making serial number, position and time jointly essential. Replacing a ring does not necessarily reset bearing life; component-level records prevent new and old parts being combined as one lifetime sample. Assume a ring is replaced after 400 h while its bearing already had 200 h; an unchanged bearing has accumulated 600 h, not 400 h or zero. A wrong serial assigns early failure to the wrong batch, while conflating complete-tool and ring-only replacement distorts life. Supplier comparisons and spare planning then inherit the same erroneous history.

Maintenance combines remaining section, bearing condition, predicted ground and inspection opportunities rather than one wear rate. Data supports professional decisions, while access to a cutterhead or pressurized chamber remains a separately approved specialist task. If 36 of an assumed 40 cutters have current valid condition records, coverage is 90%; 4 missing tools in a high-load zone cannot be dismissed by the overall percentage. Average-wear scheduling can miss one seized tool, and an unupdated ground model gives optimistic forecasts. Ignoring these limits can turn planning numbers into mistakenly assumed authorization for field work.
evidence: 交接時逐項記錄刀具半徑與行程的資料來源與適用條件。以刀位圖、轉數及地層日誌計算接觸行程，對照同類刀具的量測磨耗；將外緣與中心刀分組比較，無法追溯位置的磨耗資料不得直接用於壽命排名。
交接時逐項記錄貫入與每轉進尺的資料來源與適用條件。同步推進、轉速、推力與扭矩，將相同地層與刀具狀態下的區段比較；刀具工程師需核對載重範圍與振動，不能只以提高每轉進尺作績效目標。
交接時逐項記錄推力分配與偏載的資料來源與適用條件。核對總推力與摩擦估算，結合刀位、混合面和可用單刀量測檢查偏載；分析報告列明平均值用途和未量測峰值，不把均分模型當作所有刀具符合能力的證明。
交接時逐項記錄切削比能與條件的資料來源與適用條件。將扭矩積分與實測開挖體積核對，標記停機、空轉及換刀，對照碴片尺寸與地質；比能突升先查多種成因，再由刀具與地工人員決定是否需要獨立檢查。
交接時逐項記錄磨耗率與地層分段的資料來源與適用條件。用一致量具和基準量測刀環，將磨耗對里程、轉數和岩性分段圖示；比較相似刀位與材料，壽命外推需由刀具工程師說明穩態假設，不能以全程平均掩蓋短高磨耗區。
evidenceEn: At handover, document the evidence and applicable conditions for cutter radius and travel. Combine cutter map, revolutions and geology to calculate travel and compare measured wear for like tools; group outer and center positions separately and do not rank life from records lacking position traceability.

At handover, document the evidence and applicable conditions for penetration per revolution. Synchronize advance, rotation, thrust and torque and compare intervals with similar geology and tool condition; cutter engineers check loads and vibration instead of treating greater penetration per revolution as the sole performance objective.

At handover, document the evidence and applicable conditions for thrust distribution and uneven loading. Check thrust and friction estimates against cutter positions, mixed-face geometry and available individual measurements; state the mean's limited use and unresolved peaks instead of treating equal sharing as proof of adequate capacity everywhere.

At handover, document the evidence and applicable conditions for specific cutting energy and conditions. Check integrated torque work against measured excavation volume and mark stops, idle rotation and replacements; compare chips and geology and investigate competing causes before cutter and geotechnical specialists select further checks.

At handover, document the evidence and applicable conditions for wear rate by geological reach. Measure with consistent gauges and datum and plot wear against chainage, revolutions and geology; compare like positions and materials and require engineers to justify steady-rate extrapolation rather than hide a short severe zone in a route average.
pitfalls: 把外緣刀較快磨耗全歸於材料缺陷會錯判供應品質，刀位更換後仍沿用舊行程又會污染趨勢；壽命模型因此對下一段地層失去可比性。
少數刀先接觸硬塊時可能承受高衝擊而平均推力正常，若忽略偏載便無法解釋局部刀環崩裂；盲目增加總推力可能使問題惡化。
跨岩性平均會低估磨蝕帶的即時消耗，量具基準改變又會製造假回復；錯誤壽命預估可能讓需要計畫檢查的刀具過晚被辨識。
取樣頻率不足會把衝擊平均掉，刀具卻持續承受疲勞；只統計轉數又忽略硬軟界面轉換，可能誤把局部崩裂當成偶然製造缺陷。
序號抄錯會把早期故障歸到另一批次，更換整刀與只換刀環未區分則誇大或低估壽命；供應比較和備件計畫都會被錯誤歷程影響。
pitfallsEn: Attributing faster outer wear solely to material defects misjudges quality, while retaining old travel after relocation corrupts trends. The resulting life model loses comparability for the next geological reach.

A few tools meeting a hard inclusion can suffer high impact with normal mean thrust. Ignoring uneven loading leaves localized ring fracture unexplained and may worsen it through increased total thrust.

Averaging across lithologies understates current wear in an abrasive band, while changed measuring datums create false recovery. The resulting life estimate identifies tools requiring planned inspection too late.

Slow sampling averages impacts away while fatigue continues. Counting revolutions without interface crossings may wrongly classify localized chipping as a random manufacturing defect rather than repeated loading.

A wrong serial assigns early failure to the wrong batch, while conflating complete-tool and ring-only replacement distorts life. Supplier comparisons and spare planning then inherit the same erroneous history.

related.title: 盾尾刷與密封脂系統
related.titleEn: Shield-tail brushes and sealing grease systems
related.transfer: 可遷移「刀具半徑與行程」與「衝擊與混合面循環」的傳力分析、量測與驗證方法；盾尾刷與密封脂系統的跨度、荷載、材料與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The load-path analysis, measurement and verification methods of "Cutter radius and travel" and "Impact and mixed-face cycling" transfer, while ground conditions, loads, materials and acceptance conditions of Shield-tail brushes and sealing grease systems must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦以刀具軌跡、接觸荷重與磨耗證據解釋掘進刀具壽命；盾尾刷與密封脂系統則以以盾尾間隙、密封介質與壓力證據診斷盾尾漏水路徑為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on explain cutter life using trajectories, contact loads and wear evidence; Shield-tail brushes and sealing grease systems centres on diagnose tail-seal leakage through clearance, sealing medium and pressure evidence, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「刀具半徑與行程」與「多道刷列的阻水機制」的荷載來源、傳力路徑與主要環境作用。
把本課算例的一個假設移到盾尾刷與密封脂系統，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「灌漿與密封交互作用」為例，設計一項能區分兩種結構行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the load sources, load paths and main environmental actions of “Cutter radius and travel” and “Multiple brush-row sealing”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to Shield-tail brushes and sealing grease systems, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Grouting and seal interaction", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two structural behaviours and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.

history.year: 公開工程脈絡 / Public engineering context
history.title: 潛盾機刀具磨耗管理
history.text: 美國聯邦公路管理局於2009年發行公路隧道土建技術手冊，整理調查與土建工程的公開原理；瑞士官方介紹聖哥達基線隧道長57公里並於2016年投入營運，提供深埋長隧道的工程環境對照。Crossrail於2017年公開完工後地質縱剖面，提醒讀者鑽孔密度、偏離隧道位置與簡化斷層會限制推論。這些出版節點顯示以刀具軌跡、接觸荷重與磨耗證據解釋掘進刀具壽命需要把原始紀錄和模型分開保存；地標僅供工程環境比較，本課只重建公開原理。
history.textEn: FHWA issued its civil-elements road-tunnel manual in 2009, collecting public investigation and civil-engineering principles. Swiss government information records the 57 km Gotthard Base Tunnel entering operation in 2016, providing context for long deep tunnels. Crossrail published a post-construction geological section in 2017, explaining limitations from borehole density, offset and simplified faults. These publication milestones show why explain cutter life using trajectories, contact loads and wear evidence requires original observations to be preserved separately from interpretations. Landmarks provide contextual comparisons only; this course reconstructs public principles.
